entities.summary: Poprad Ice Stadium is an arena in Poprad, Slovakia. It is primarily used for ice hockey and is the home ice of HK Poprad. It has a capacity of 4,500 people and was built in 1973 and renovated in 2011. During the 2011–12 KHL season, it was also the home arena of Lev Poprad, which was playing in the Kontinental Hockey League.
